quadruped animal with legs shown in side view
horizontal register/band framing the figural scene
row of repeated motifs along the top border
human or humanoid figure alongside animals
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief animals in profile beneath a horizontal band of repeated motifs at the top, and both include a quadruped with a raised head, which is a fairly generic correspondence. The specifics differ sharply: A depicts a naturalistic two-humped pack animal led by a robed man with a staff under a border of rosettes, while B shows schematic, angular predatory beasts, a long-necked bird, a snake-like animal and an arcaded band of abstract signs stacked in several unrelated registers without any leading or handling relationship.
